commands: set -euo pipefail; git fetch origin main; git checkout main; git reset --hard origin/main; echo arch=$(uname -m); if command -v brew >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo brew_path=$(command -v brew); brew --version | head -1; echo brew_present=true; brew info cloudflared --json=v2 | python3 -c 'import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); f=d.get("formulae",[]); print("cloudflared_formula=" + (f[0].get("versions",{}).get("stable","unknown") if f else "missing"))'; else echo brew_present=false; fi; test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"; echo install_audit_green=true
